description: PyGRDECL is a Python library for converting Eclipse or Petrel GRDECL reservoir grids and property arrays to VTU files for viewing in ParaView. Its public GitHub README describes the GRDECL-to-VTK workflow and lists Linux and Windows use with VTK and Shapely dependencies. The repository states the BSD 3-Clause licence; code is free to access. Reservoir modellers can use it to inspect mesh geometry, porosity or permeability fields before flow simulation or storage-capacity analysis. It is a conversion and visualisation tool, not a reservoir-flow solver or proof that a mesh is numerically valid. A limitation is that the README's installation instructions cite older dependency versions, so current environment compatibility needs testing. No geographical or temporal dataset is bundled as the main resource; coverage comes from user-supplied grids. It can process LUNDIsim GRDECL meshes, which are a separate G3 draft. No directly related GRDECL conversion tool exists in the current catalogue. No code or model mesh was downloaded or executed.
name: PyGRDECL reservoir grid conversion library
notes: G3 G3-0554. Draft only. No resource files downloaded or software executed. The GDJ70030 article cites it as a way to inspect LUNDIsim meshes. The LUNDIsim dataset is already G3-0163.  Language: Python.
